# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight young man with a wide, freckle-covered face that is round and devoid of expression. He is noted for his physical size and simple facial expressions.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Barney possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter and suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Extremely bashful and timid when it comes to courtship, he tends to occupy corners in social settings and responds to being spoken to with quiet laughs. Despite his social awkwardness, he is a fine, hardworking, and reliable man of good sense who holds no vices and treats others with kindness.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

- Timid and bashful  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and physical labor  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- Taking a bride and starting a farm before spring planting  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

Barney Pullen lived in Brierley with his family and often drove a carriage to local events alongside his sister Odette. Harboring vast admiration for Nell Harcourt, he insisted she ride next to him on the way to a concert in Pale Sands, feeling immense pride despite his inability to converse. After his father gave him title to the upper farm, Barney sought to marry Nell; however, being too timid to court her directly, he persistently harassed Odette until she agreed to propose to Nell on his behalf, offering to wait until she finished college. Upon Nell's firm refusal, Barney demonstrated his good sense and turned his attentions toward Nettie Scobie, whom his mother favored. He subsequently married Nettie, escorting her proudly into the family church pew in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
